text:
maria: quick review needed: inline rate-limit error copy on Console > Requests. product changed the message and i think it's a little abrupt for users hitting quota during demos. current root msg: `Error 429: Too many requests.`

maria: proposed friendly variations:
A) `Request limit reached. Try again in a few seconds or upgrade to increase throughput.`
B) `You're sending requests too quickly. Wait a moment and retry, or upgrade for higher throughput.`
C) `We've hit the request limit for this account. Retry shortly or upgrade your plan.`

tony: i prefer B — gives clear next steps and keeps tone conversational.

oli: accessibility note: avoid contractions? B uses "You're" which is fine for friendly UX but screen readers fine either way. main thing is include `Retry-After` semantics in tooltip and expose machine-readable header in logs.

maria: tooltip when hovering the small question icon next to the error should explain the retry timing and link to docs. current tooltip: `Retry after X seconds. See docs for rate limits.`

tony: shorter tooltip options:
- `Retry after Xs. See /docs/rate-limits`
- `Try again in Xs. Learn about limits.`
- `Reduce request rate or upgrade. Retry in Xs.`

oli: prefer `Try again in Xs. Learn about limits.` — actionable and uses plain language. accessibility: tooltip must include the timestamp/seconds in text and be updated live if we show a countdown. aria-live region for countdown recommended.

maria: ok. what about the confirmation modal when we surface an upgrade CTA from the error inline? current modal copy: `Upgrade to increase throughput. Proceed?` feels transactional and vague.

tony: suggestion: `Upgrade to a higher plan to raise your request limit and reduce throttling. View pricing or upgrade now.` buttons: `View pricing` / `Upgrade now` / `Cancel`

oli: wording note: keep modal body short and put details in the pricing page. Also include the relevant SKU name if we can prefill (e.g., "Pro plan") for clarity. For accessibility, ensure the primary button has focus and modal has descriptive aria-labelledby.

maria: agreed. final modal draft:
`Upgrade to Pro to increase your request limit and reduce throttling. View pricing or upgrade now.`
Buttons: `View pricing` (secondary), `Upgrade now` (primary), `Cancel`

tony: tiny copy nit for inline error — add an emoji? maybe a small :hourglass_flowing_sand: before the message in the toast to soften tone. what do you all think?

oli: emojis okay in ephemeral toasts but keep them out of formal error banners in enterprise accounts. opt-in per org setting?

maria: good point. we'll show emoji only in trial and self-serve contexts.

design-bot: created figma frame "Rate limit copy variants" at 1774501270.

tony: follow-up: telemetry event names: `request.error.429.inline_shown` and `request.error.429.upgrade_cta_click` so we can A/B the three inline copies.

maria: i'll A/B test B vs C — leaning B. i'll update the copy tokens and add aria-live for the tooltip countdown. will post final strings when pushed. :sparkles:
